lean-agent-context-test.name: Lean + Agent Context (Test Bundle)
lean-agent-context-test.description: Test bundle exercising the bundle authoring/install path. Composes the Lean Workflow preset with the Agent Context extension so a fresh project gets a minimal command surface plus automatic agent-context refresh after /speckit.specify and /speckit.plan.
lean-agent-context-test.author: speckit-wizard
lean-agent-context-test.bundle_yml:
schema_version: "1.0"

bundle:
  id: lean-agent-context-test
  name: Lean + Agent Context (Test Bundle)
  version: 0.1.0
  role: developer
  description: >-
    Test bundle exercising the bundle authoring/install path. Composes the
    Lean Workflow preset with the Agent Context extension so a fresh project
    gets a minimal command surface plus automatic agent-context refresh
    after /speckit.specify and /speckit.plan.
  author: speckit-wizard
  license: MIT

requires:
  speckit_version: ">=0.9.0"

integration:
  id: copilot

provides:
  presets:
    - id: lean
      version: 1.0.0
      priority: 10
      strategy: replace
  extensions:
    - id: agent-context
      version: 1.0.0

tags:
  - test
  - lean
  - agent-context
